signOffConditionVerdicts.note: An unauditable allow is denied for the actuating classes, payload and manual-control, and counted but allowed for command, parameter and mission. The split is deliberate: denying everywhere turns an audit sink failure into a flight-control failure, so a full disk would start refusing commands mid-flight including the command to land. Denying nowhere leaves the trail with a hole precisely where actuation happened. P7-AUDIT-003 is answered as deny-for-actuating.

guardPermissions.reason: The scope and the evaluation point are settled, so the gate can enforce rather than warn.

Selecting a seam for the payload class says where an operator-requested payload operation is authorised. It does not permit the station to drive an actuator, which stays the payload controller concern.
Nothing in the scope decision permits the station to originate a payload action without an operator asking for one.

settled.element: the selected outbound authorization scope among the recorded options A, B and C

entries.value: Option C: a layered model with a distinct seam per outbound class, each gated where that class converges. The classes are command, parameter, mission, manual-control and payload. Option A was rejected because it leaves startCalibration, which can spin motors, permanently ungated. Option B was rejected because its recorded blocking issue stands: it requires a policy able to decide arbitrary message types, and it evaluates heartbeats and telemetry requests with signing and timing consequences the audit records as not yet assessed, in three upstream hot-path files.

settled.element: the point at which the station evaluates an authorization

entries.value: Per class, at the convergence point the outbound audit already identified. The command class is evaluated at MavCommandQueue::sendWorker() through QGCCorePlugin::authorizeMavCommand(), which is built and needs no further core edit. The parameter class is evaluated at ParameterManager::_mavlinkParamSet, candidate C1. A class with no seam yet is recorded as out of scope with an owner rather than left implicit, which is what makes the model incremental: a class closes without reopening the ones already closed.

settled.element: the command classes the authorization scope distinguishes

entries.value: Queued MAV_CMD traffic. The seam is MavCommandQueue::sendWorker() through QGCCorePlugin::authorizeMavCommand(), together with Vehicle::startCalibration() under ADR-015. Built today. An unauditable allow is counted and allowed.
Parameter writes. The seam is ParameterManager::_mavlinkParamSet, candidate C1 of the outbound audit. Not built; owner Tab 2. An unauditable allow is counted and allowed.
Mission upload, download and clear. No seam is built; owner Tab 2, and the class is recorded out of scope with an owner rather than left implicit. An unauditable allow is counted and allowed.
Manual control and joystick axes. No seam is built; owner Tab 2. Actuating, so an unauditable allow is denied under P7-AUDIT-003.

Payload operations an operator requests. No seam is built; owner Tab 2. Actuating, so an unauditable allow is denied under P7-AUDIT-003. Recording the class permits no station-side actuation and no station-originated payload action.
